title: Concept: Google Cloud service account key JSON served in a response
description: A downloaded service account key is a long-lived credential with no second factor and no user behind it. Served from a web path it is reachable by anyone who guesses the filename, which for build artefacts is usually a directory listing away.
applicability: Responses that serve build output, CI artefacts or a misconfigured storage path.
risk: The caller authenticates as the service account and inherits every permission bound to it, including data access and resource creation.
